summary: PASS. Expo web preview is stable after the --tunnel flag was removed from supervisord.conf. Preview at http://localhost:3000/ returns HTTP 200, all 5 tab routes (/, /explore, /quest, /(tabs)/food → /food, /profile, /map) render distinct, correct content. Map tab correctly renders the intended 'Native map view' fallback banner (MapLibre RN is native-only). POI detail (/poi/poi-gaz-001-panorama-museum-25-december) renders title, CVS badge 96/100, KÜLTÜR YOLU #1, About, and full Location & access section (rating 4.8 · 4,965 reviews, Mon-Sun 08:30-17:00, address, phone, panorama25aralik.com/tr). Supervisor status is RUNNING with PID 9997 stable across ~4+ minutes of monitoring (uptime 0:53 → 1:10 → 1:55 → 2:50 → 4:03). No new 'ngrok tunnel took too long' errors have been written to expo.err.log since the fix (file mtime 18:29:58 predates current expo start at ~18:30:02; all ngrok lines are historical from before the fix). Backend regression sweep: 7/7 pytest tests pass (supabase health configured=true, cities/gaziantep, 118 POIs, exactly 53 kultur-yolu places, cvs-summary with 118 keys, leaderboard, POI check-in at Panorama Museum coords). Only frontend console noise is React Native web deprecation warnings ('shadow*' → boxShadow, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents) — non-blocking. No red-screen errors, no page errors.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warnings on every render: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-blocking noise, but future React Native / RN-web versions may drop support. Grep the frontend for `shadowColor|shadowOffset|shadowOpacity|shadowRadius` and inline `pointerEvents` props to migrate.

rca_of_issue: RCA: A previous deployment_agent fix added `--tunnel` to the Expo supervisor start command. In this environment @expo/ngrok wasn't installed globally and ngrok couldn't establish a tunnel non-interactively, so `expo start --tunnel --port 3000` exited with code 1 repeatedly ('Input is required, but npx expo is in non-interactive mode' then later 'ngrok tunnel took too long to connect'). Supervisor kept restarting expo → crash-loop. Fix (already applied by main agent): reverted line 4 of /etc/supervisor/conf.d/supervisord.conf to `command=yarn expo start --port 3000` and ran supervisorctl reread/update/restart. Verified: PID stable 4+ min, no new ngrok errors since restart, HTTP 200 on /, all 5 tab routes plus POI detail render, backend regression 7/7 pass. Mitigation for future: keep tunnel mode off in Emergent env — EXPO_PACKAGER_PROXY_URL already handles external access.
